selected_option.meaning: Authorize a separately bounded activation, canonical-event migration, and cutover execution envelope for this exact tested candidate.

authorization.scope: exact admitted epoch-002 product and exact tested 7-to-11 canonical-event migration only
authorization.reversibility: A later explicit owner decision may supersede this authorization; this exact decision and candidate remain immutable history. Any execution must preserve the tested rollback route.

execution_prerequisites.requirement: Bind one exact live runtime and data target without globs or unresolved environment variables.
Bind the exact credential identity, least-privilege scope, secret handling boundary, and revocation route.
Bind the exact maintenance window, service owner, observer, and abort authority.
Freeze live preimages, canonical source event cut, state digests, and backup or rollback locators.
Define ordered effects, precondition checks, postimage checks, first-failure stop, and exact rollback triggers.
Independently validate the complete execution envelope against this decision and all current dependency hashes.

non_effects: This decision does not itself activate the admitted runtime or v2 Context Map.
This decision does not itself append, migrate, delete, or rewrite live events or state.
This decision does not itself perform cutover or rollback.
This decision does not identify or authorize any credential, destructive operation, live target, maintenance window, publication, release, or deployment.
This decision cannot be executed directly; all execution prerequisites must be bound and independently validated in one exact successor envelope.
Changed candidate, product, event, context, challenge-contract, runtime, or live-target bytes fail closed and require a new reviewed envelope or decision.
claim_ceiling: D65CUT-1 conditionally authorizes an exact successor envelope for activation, the tested canonical-event migration, cutover, and tested rollback of the admitted epoch-002 product. No runtime, event, data, credential, service, publication, release, deployment, destructive action, or external state is changed by this decision; execution remains not ready until every exact prerequisite is bound and independently validated.
